metadata.question: Does nitrogen dioxide concentration in Wuhan city, China decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2 collection because it provides tropospheric NO₂ column data at ~3.5 km resolution; both daily (−OFFL) and monthly climatologies are available. Area of interest: a ~10 km buffer around central Wuhan (30.58 °N, 114.27 °E) so we average many pixels and avoid single-pixel instability. Period 1 (reference): 1 Jan – 20 Jan 2020 Period 2 (lock-down): 10 Feb – 25 Feb 2020 2. Masking / QA: The OFFL NO2 product ships with an ‘qa_value’ band; values ≥ 0.75 indicate high-quality retrievals. We mask pixels < 0.75 (keep good data). 3. Logic: - Build the two collections; if either has size 0 → C1. - Apply qa mask then compute mean per-pixel tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density for each period. - Reduce regionally within the Wuhan buffer; get counts. If count == 0 → C2. - If either mean value is None/NaN → C3. - Compare: if mean(P2) < mean(P1) → decrease → A; else → B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point(114.27, 30.58).buffer(10000) # 10 km buffer p1_start, p1_end = '2020-01-01', '2020-01-20' p2_start, p2_end = '2020-02-10', '2020-02-25' def collNo2(start, end): c = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P_OFFL_L3_NO2') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(wuhan) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value')) return c # 2. Check availability col1 = collNo2(p1_start, p1_end) col2 = collNo2(p2_start, p2_end) n1, n2 = col1.size().getInfo(), col2.size().getInfo() print(f"Jan: {n1} imgs, Feb: {n2} imgs") if n1 == 0 or n2 == 0: print("C1") def meanNo2(col, label): masked = col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75))) comp = masked.mean().multiply(1e15) # mol/m² → 10¹⁵ molec/cm² valObj = comp.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), wuhan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) val = valObj.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() cnt = comp.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), wuhan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() print(f"{label} mean NO₂: {val:.2f} (pixels: {int(cnt)})") if cnt == 0: print("C2") if val is None or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(val).getInfo(): print("C3") return val, cnt v1, _ = meanNo2(col1, "Jan") v2, _ = meanNo2(col2, "Feb") print("NO₂ (Jan): %.2f -> (Feb): %.2f" % (v1, v2)) if v2 < v1: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point(114.27, 30.58).buffer(10000)  # 10 km buffer
p1_start, p1_end = '2020-01-01', '2020-01-20'
p2_start, p2_end = '2020-02-10', '2020-02-25'

def collNo2(start, end):
    c = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P_OFFL_L3_NO2')
           .filterDate(start, end)
           .filterBounds(wuhan)
           .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value'))
    return c

# 2. Check availability
col1 = collNo2(p1_start, p1_end)
col2 = collNo2(p2_start, p2_end)
n1, n2 = col1.size().getInfo(), col2.size().getInfo()
print(f"Jan: {n1} imgs, Feb: {n2} imgs")
if n1 == 0 or n2 == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

def meanNo2(col, label):
    masked = col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75)))
    comp = masked.mean().multiply(1e15)  # mol/m² → 10¹⁵ molec/cm²
    valObj = comp.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), wuhan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9)
    val = valObj.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    cnt = comp.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), wuhan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    print(f"{label} mean NO₂: {val:.2f} (pixels: {int(cnt)})")
    if cnt == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    if val is None or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(val).getInfo():
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    return val, cnt

v1, _ = meanNo2(col1, "Jan")
v2, _ = meanNo2(col2, "Feb")

print("NO₂ (Jan): %.2f  -> (Feb): %.2f" % (v1, v2))
if v2 < v1:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
